description: This file defines the interface and class implementation for the MigrationPreparer component within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes method declarations for managing a JSON-based datastore, component readiness, and reset functionalities, along with associated private helpers and data members.

classes.name: MigrationPreparerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IMigrationPreparer interface, providing methods to manage migration data, component readiness, and reset operations within the plugin.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to the JSON datastore.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the JSON datastore based on the key.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the value associated with a key from the JSON datastore.

methods.name: setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Sets the readiness status for a specified component.

methods.name: getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components marked as ready.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Performs a reset operation based on the specified reset type.
